capabilities: Select whole tables as blocks with arrow keys, like selecting an image
Navigate and select cells without opening the raw Markdown
Drop into a cell for editing with Enter
Freeze rows and columns while scrolling long or wide tables
Copy, delete, or replace whole tables from block selection
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Works only in Live Preview; source mode, reading view, and tables in callouts or list items are untouched. Freezes are stored as a %%freeze r c%% comment in the header row. Known issues on iPhone/iPad include flickering frozen rows and drag selection not working with frozen tables.
intentEvidence: Treats tables as selectable blocks, the same way Obsidian treats an image.
motivation: One of the original objectives was to make scrolling notes with large tables a little more seamless, especially tables with Markdown inside cells.
problem: Moving the caret through large Markdown tables cell by cell causes flickering, stuttering, and a table that resizes as Obsidian reveals each cell's Markdown.
summary: Keyboard navigation plugin that treats Markdown tables as selectable blocks in Live Preview and can freeze rows and columns.
